summary: Admin panel update: remove standalone Accounts area; enable banning and managing user accounts directly from an Order view.
architectural_notes: Admin user/account management actions should be accessible via the Order details view; no separate Accounts admin area.

existing_features.title: Remove the standalone “Accounts” area from the Admin Panel UI (including its tab trigger, tab content, and any related lazy imports) so admins no longer manage accounts from a separate Admin Accounts section.
Add account management controls to admin order management so an admin can ban/unban and manage VIP status for the account tied to an order directly from the order UI.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove the Accounts area/section from the admin panel UI.
Allow admins to ban and manage user accounts from within an order (manage the account tied to an order).
Provide a backend API to fetch account status for a specific principal (used by the order-linked account management UI) without requiring loading the entire accounts list.

projectName: Remove Admin Accounts tab and manage user accounts from Orders
